decisions.reason: This camera is very close to our core optical and navigation competencies, and our strong in-house R&D and research partnerships give us high capacity to refine it and learn from early market feedback.

The modular navigation camera builds directly on our established space imaging know-how and fits our strategic move toward more flexible sensor systems, so it is a good candidate for continued commercialization and improvement.

The sensor suite extends our existing spacecraft sensing capabilities into an adjacent application where our accumulated systems knowledge and cooperative research links should support further adaptation and market uptake.

Although its market presence appears less developed so far, the miniaturized LiDAR sensor remains closely related to our sensor and miniaturization capabilities and is worth retaining because our absorptive capacity should help us improve it for future small-satellite demand.
